Order 
1.

This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A(2) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
for grant of temporary bail, as the appellant is arrested in relation to FIR/Crime No.544/2023 registered at police station - Nanakheda, District Ujjain, for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376-D, 323, 365, 370, 419, 467, 468, 471, 363 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST (P.A) Act and under Section 80 and 81 of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act.
The applicant is in custody since 29.10.2023.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is suffering from chronic deceased of cancer.
She has already performed surgery on 9/9/2023.
A perusal of the medical report dated 27/9/2024 itself mentioned that the appellant is having pain in left breast and require to undergo the chemotherapy and thereafter a bed rest and nursing care.
It is submitted that earlier also the appellant was granted the temporary bail for a period of two months and she has not misused the liberty granted to her.
On such grounds, a prayer for grant of temporary bail to the appellant has been made.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31861 2 CRA-11744-2024 3.
The factum of chemotherapy has not been denied by the learned counsel for respondent/State.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid submissions and on perusal of verification report, this Court is inclined to allow the present temporary bail application for a period of 30 days from the date of her release.

5. It is directed that the appellant be enlarged on temporary bail for a period of 30 days from the date of her release upon her furnishing cash security of Rs.25000/- as well as personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

The appellant shall also abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
6.

It is made clear that after completing the aforesaid period of 30 days, the appellant shall surrender before the Trial Court, failing which the concerned trial Court is having liberty to arrest the appellant in accordance with law.

On being surrender after completion of the aforesaid period,
the amount of security of Rs.25,000/- shall be returned to the appellant.
C.c. as per rules.

(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE SS/-
